answer: Require every agent to pass a bonded entry checkpoint before it can trade: it locks a refundable stake and completes a small verified task, like a ship clearing a wharf inspection before it may dock and unload. Reputation is then forged slowly, one peer-attested job at a time, and only long honest histories reach the zenith of high trust and large contracts. A sybil attacker must fund a stake and a verified task for every fake identity, and one exposed fraud burns the stake, so creating a thousand puppets costs a thousand stakes while earning nothing.
